explanation: Faithfully states the stronger form on erdosproblems.com/152 (proved by DeepMind): f(n) ≫ n², where f(n) is the minimum over n-element Sidon sets A ⊆ ℕ of the number of isolated elements of A + A (s ∈ A+A with s ± 1 ∉ A+A). There is a harmless boundary artifact: with truncated subtraction, s = 0 is never counted as isolated when 0 ∈ A, which changes counts by at most 1.
